preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (deployer)
Attacker must hold some MARSINU tokens to demonstrate the exploit

violation_target.exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setTaxFeePercent() and setLiquidityFeePercent() to set both fees to values that sum to 100 (e.g., 50 each). Then perform a token transfer to another address - the transfer amount will be reduced to near zero due to the 100% fee, effectively locking user funds. The owner can also exclude themselves from fees using excludeFromFee() to avoid being affected.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The contract allows the owner to set tax and liquidity fees arbitrarily. By setting both to 50% (total 100%), any transfer will result in near-zero tokens being received by the recipient, with all tokens taken as fees. The owner can exclude themselves from fees and later extract the accumulated fees from the contract.
attempts.attack_strategy: Impersonate the owner, exclude ourselves from fees, set fees to 100% total, then have a victim transfer tokens to demonstrate fund loss. The attacker benefits by accumulating fees in the contract which they control.
attempts.step_by_step_plan:
1. Impersonate owner using vm.prank
2. Exclude attacker from fees
3. Set tax fee to 50%
4. Set liquidity fee to 50%
5. Create victim with tokens
6. Have victim transfer tokens
7. Show contract balance increased (fees accumulated)
8. Owner can later extract these fees
